PPA5500_1500_500 Series Brochure
Product catalog summary
Overview: This document outlines the technical specifications and features of the Precision Power Analyzers, specifically the PPA5500, PPA1500, and PPA500 series. These analyzers are designed for high-accuracy power measurement across a wide frequency range, suitable for applications such as power analysis, harmonic analysis, and real-time data logging.
Specifications:
Accuracy and Frequency Range: The PPA5500 offers a basic accuracy of 0.02% with a frequency range from DC to 2MHz. The PPA1500 ranges up to 1MHz, and the PPA500 up to 500kHz.
Sample Rate: The PPA5500 samples at 2.2M samples/s, while the PPA1500 and PPA500 sample at 1M samples/s.
Phase Accuracy: Leading phase accuracy is 0.005 degrees plus 0.01 degrees per kHz.
Current Shunt: Built-in high precision current shunt options include 10Arms, 30Arms, or 50Arms with up to 1000Apk direct.
Interfaces: Includes RS232, USB, GPIB, LAN, and direct torque and speed interfaces.
Features:
High-Speed Power Measurement: The PPA5500 maintains a 2.2Ms/s sampling rate at any drive frequency, capturing all frequency components in power waveforms.
Wideband Frequency Response: The PPA5500 provides a 2MHz bandwidth for precision analysis in applications like lighting ballasts and PWM drives.
Real-Time No Gap Analysis: Utilizes DFT techniques for accurate power measurement without data gaps.
6 Phase Analysis: Master/Slave mode allows synchronization of two PPA5530 units for 6 phase measurement.
Measurement Modes:
Power Integrator Mode: Measures power consumption over time.
Harmonic Analyzer: Provides up to 375 harmonics analysis for aerospace applications.
Oscilloscope Mode: Displays voltage and current waveforms (not available in PPA500).
Data Logging and PC Control:
Internal Memory: The PPA5500 series includes a 1GB internal memory for data logging.
PC Software: Allows remote control, data storage, and real-time data display via USB, RS232, or LAN.
Standby Power Testing: Full compliance testing to IEC62301 standards.
Applications: The analyzers are suitable for various applications including PWM motor drives, ballast lighting systems, inrush current analysis, power transformer testing, and standby power measurement.
Additional Specifications: The document provides detailed specifications for the PPA5500 and PPA1500/PPA500 series power analyzers, including crest factor, sample rate, standby power compliance, application modes, frequency range, voltage and current input ranges, accuracy, phase accuracy, power accuracy, and common mode rejection ratio (CMRR).
Models: The PPA5500 series is available in multiple phase configurations (1 to 6 phases) with different current handling capabilities (10Arms, 30Arms, 50Arms). The PPA1500/PPA500 series also offers similar configurations with varying current capacities.
Accessories: Standard accessories include power leads, connection cables, and communication software. Optional accessories include rack mount kits, carrying cases, and various interface options like LAN and GPIB.
Product Comparison: The document compares the PPA5500 with other models like PPA1500/PPA500 and PPA2500/PPA2600, highlighting differences in basic accuracy, power reading error, voltage input, frequency band, features, and dimensions.
Company Information: Newtons4th Ltd, established in 1997, specializes in sophisticated test equipment related to phase measurement. The company is ISO9001 registered and has received the "Innovation 2010" Queen's award for enterprise.
